about: Benefit retrieval golden set. Synthetic portfolios of public products; no real holdings. Labels come from each rule's title, summary, category and scenario in src/data/knowledge/rules.json, never from running the retriever. A reference is ALIAS:suffix, which expands to rule.<productId>.<suffix>. expected = should be in the top 12; acceptable = defensible either way, not scored; forbidden = must not appear. ambiguous questions are reported but not scored. absent questions have no relevant rule in the portfolio; the right answer is no results. rewrite is the hand-written ideal find_benefits call(s): a short query in the user's language plus filters chosen only from the question and the tool's enums, never from rule ids or titles. alsoAnsweredBy marks questions another read-only tool answers as asked, by a written rule applied to every dev question: a points-transfer or miles-earning question → get_card_rules transfer-relationship; a question asking for a rebate or more points on a kind of spend → choose_card. The rule was written after the first live run, so it is a scoring convention, not a blind label; held-out questions carry none. Well-known English brand names (Delta Stays, American Airlines Vacations) count as general knowledge a model has.
